name: io.github.zachshallbetter/adobe-mcp-photoshop
title: Photoshop MCP Server
description: Drive Adobe Photoshop from any MCP client: layers, selections, adjustments, type and export.

environmentVariables.name: PHOTOSHOP_APP_NAME
environmentVariables.description: macOS only: address a specific copy, e.g. "Adobe Photoshop 2025". Default: Photoshop by bundle id

environmentVariables.name: PHOTOSHOP_ALLOWED_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Extra directories allowed for file operations (':' on macOS, ';' on Windows)

environmentVariables.name: PHOTOSHOP_SCRIPT_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: How long to wait for Photoshop before reporting that a dialog may be open. Default 120000
